blocks.text: React ES6 Classes
Classes
ES6 introduced classes.

A class is a type of function, but instead of using the keyword
function to initiate it, we use the keyword
class, and the properties are assigned inside a
constructor() method.

We have begun the name, "Car", with an uppercase character.

Class Inheritance

To create a class inheritance, use the extends
keyword.

A class created with a class inheritance inherits all the methods from
another class:

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text:
The super() method refers to the parent
class.

By calling the super() method in the
constructor method, we call the parent's constructor method and get access to
the parent's properties and methods.
